mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Products (rent_sale_type, product_status, product_type, price, quantity, seller_user_id, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{rentSaleType}, #{productStatus}, #{productType}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{sellerUserId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE Products SET rent_sale_type = #{rentSaleType}, product_status = #{productStatus}, product_type = #{productType}, price = #{price}, quantity = #{quantity}, seller_user_id = #{sellerUserId}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE id = #{id}
